title: Escapewheel source resolution document
description: Shape of sources.json. Maps a source name declared by an external resource entry to where that body of data is, and a location prefix to the one standing for it, for one reader in one situation. It is not a packet resource, so packet immutability does not reach it; a location can be corrected when a mirror moves.

$schema.description: This document's meta-schema, by $id: identity rather than a fetch instruction, so a reader neither dereferences nor requires it.

sources_standard_version.description: Which version of this document format is in use, so a reader refuses a future one rather than misreading it. A v0.1 document states only absolute URIs and POSIX paths, and no mirror.

description.description: Human context: whose mirror this is, and for whom. Read by nothing.

sources.description: Source name to where that source is. A name is opaque to this specification and matches the `source` field of an external resource entry.

uri.description: Where this source is: an absolute URI, a POSIX or Windows absolute path, or a relative reference resolved against the directory or prefix holding this document. A resource's own `uri` is a path relative to this.

description.description: Human context for this one source. Read by nothing.

mirrors.description: Location prefix to the directory or prefix standing for it, matched by decoded names.

uri.description: What stands for the prefix: an absolute URI, a POSIX or Windows absolute path, a relative reference resolved against the directory or prefix holding this document, or empty for that directory or prefix itself.

description.description: Human context for this one mirror. Read by nothing.
